title: A class with an invariant
prompt: Implement `class BoundedCounter` with a private `int value_{0};` and private `int max_;`, a constructor `BoundedCounter(int max)` that stores `max` (assume positive), `void increment()` that increments unless doing so would exceed `max`, and `int value() const` / `int max() const` getters.

tests.name: stops-at-max
tests.hint: The fourth increment would exceed max 3 → invariant forbids it.

tests.name: getters-const
tests.hint: Both getters must work through a const reference.
